barnaby:
A returning customer! Or witness!
I've updated the label since we met.
vesper:
You again! I'd steal this reunion,
but I haven't paid for the cards.
marlo:
My esteemed former opponent!
The judge has bought a second hat.
clatter:
A familiar challenger! You will
find the regulations much shorter.
mosswick:
Ah! My previous grand-entrance
witness! The mushrooms remember you.
nyxie:
We've met. How lovely to skip
the part about the parasol.
sable:
Hey, it's you. I've been
practicing the listening part.
opaline:
Oh, hello again. I restocked
the emergency courage pocket.
cinder:
Familiar face, new testing ground.
The equipment still buzzes.
dahlia:
We meet again. The flowers have
had time to develop their opinions.
echo:
Hey! I kept our last match.
Let's see what I learned from it.
briar:
You again! The COMBEE remember
your contribution to field testing.
fable:
A returning character!
I saved a blank page for this.
taffy:
There you are! New ribbons,
same extremely determined team!
roux:
Oh, hey. I've been working
on a new solo since our last match.
hugo:
A familiar face! Excellent.
The soup debate needs fresh evidence.
otis:
Hello again! I've saved you
a metaphorical biscuit. Let's battle.
bastian:
We meet again! I have collected
several more complicated salad questions.
monty:
Hey! You remember the routine.
This time I've timed the introduction.
florian:
It's good to see you again.
The centerpiece has been training too.
orson:
My worthy rival returns!
The sandwich has acquired a sequel!
kestrel:
You again! Forecast update:
a strong chance of a second battle.
juniper:
Good to see you! I've checked
the ropes. Your team looks ready too.
solace:
Hello again. I've tuned the
chimes since our last meeting.
idris:
My cloud rival has competition!
Welcome back to the ground division.
fen:
Oh, hello! I've added our last
meeting to the interesting-routes notes.
taro:
A familiar face! The coat has
a new patch and I have a new plan.
cosmo:
My returning star! Tonight's
program includes a second performance!
nettle:
You again. This time I've
put on enough water for another pot.
miri:
Oh, hello! I've learned a new
arrangement and two more apologies.
zephyr:
Welcome back! I've practiced
the bit where I stay upright.
elden:
Good to see you again.
Different place, different light.
